about.title: I'm Ali Emre.
about.highlight: A software engineer with a passion for design.
about.description: From a young age, I had a strong talent for drawing and a vivid imagination. Over time, I transformed this skill into digital design during computer classes, which also sparked my curiosity for technology. My passion for technology became the main reason I chose to pursue computer engineering, while my interest in design has continued to influence my work, especially in frontend development and creating better user experiences.

I'm an experienced full-stack software engineer focused on building reliable and practical systems. I work across frontend, backend, and infrastructure to deliver complete solutions. I care about clean architecture, maintainable code, and turning ideas into working products quickly. I enjoy AI-assisted development to rapidly prototype, iterate, and transform ideas into reliable tools.

experiences.description: Working on an AI coworker platform for small businesses with integrations. Resolved critical WebSocket connectivity issues, improving connection stability and handling reconnection logic across various edge cases. Refactored the codebase progressively, introducing type safety without disrupting an actively used production app. Currently leading a full UI redesign, giving the product a consistent visual identity that aligns with the company's branding. AI-assisted development is a core part of the workflow, used to prototype quickly and iterate with confidence in a fast-paced startup environment.

Worked full-stack on two network automation platforms used by network engineers to streamline and monitor complex, repetitive workflows. On the first, a long-running internal platform, contributed new features including an integrations module that allowed workflows to connect with external APIs, and focused heavily on code refactoring and cleanup to improve the overall codebase quality. On the second, a greenfield commercial product built from scratch, collaborated with software architects on foundational system and technology decisions, taking ownership of the frontend stack selection with open-source licensing requirements in mind. Also developed a standalone Python tool that connects to network devices over SSH, runs commands to collect data, and saves the output directly into a pre-styled Word document, generating ready-to-use reports automatically and replacing a fully manual process. Supported interns and junior developers during onboarding.

projects.name: CRC ML Classifier
projects.description: Bachelor graduation thesis project developing a colorectal cancer classification tool using machine learning. Built a multi-stage Python and R pipeline covering data preprocessing, classifier training with grid search optimization, and survival analysis to identify potential biomarkers. Focused on building a reproducible data analysis pipeline as a practical and cost-effective alternative to traditional classification methods.

projects.name: Eye Controlled Wheelchair
projects.description: Developed an assistive system enabling people with spinal cord paralysis to control a wheelchair through eye movements. Used Dlib for facial landmark detection and OpenCV for real-time pupil tracking, translating eye direction into movement commands sent over Wi-Fi to an ESP32-based wheelchair prototype. A standalone Python application connecting computer vision with embedded hardware.

projects.name: 2048 Hand Gesture
projects.description: Built a hand gesture-controlled version of the 2048 game as an embedded systems project. Uses a webcam and OpenCV to detect hand gestures in real time, translating movement direction into game controls. Originally developed on a Raspberry Pi 2, but runs on any Python-supported system.

projects.name: RGBulb App
projects.description: An Android app built with Flutter to control an IoT RGB LED module made with NodeMCU and an RGB LED. The app uses the MQTT protocol to send LED control commands and can be operated from an external network.

projects.name: Fly By Wire AB Website
projects.description: The website was built with React, featuring a clean 2D outlined design with a coding font aesthetic. The result is a playful yet professional interface that reflects the company's innovative and technical spirit.

projects.name: Shuttlefly Effect Game
projects.description: A storytelling space game where players guide three astronauts back to Earth after a shuttle accident. Each astronaut has unique skills, and choices affect health, morale, oxygen, and resources. Inspired by Reigns.

graphicDesigns.name: BKLMUN
graphicDesigns.description: It's a Model United Nations event organized by a group of high school students. I served as Head of Press and also handled the graphic designs. All of the designs and the general concept were my original idea.

graphicDesigns.name: TEDx Yildiz Technical University
graphicDesigns.description: It is part of the global TEDx initiative, created to share 'ideas worth spreading.' This event is organized by the student club SPARK, where I served as General Director. During my tenure, I contributed extensively through design work and also edited some of the talks, helping bring the event's vision to life visually.
